name: Platanus Hack

prizes.name: Cash pool
prizes.reward: USD 3,000 split among winners; best team goes to the LATAM final in Chile (November)

judging.notes: Hacking alongside Anthropic. A public voting page exists; official results page not retrievable on 2026-09-14.

entries.name: Aegis
entries.tagline: Stops your data leaking to ChatGPT and ~170 other AIs, deciding on-device and explaining each block.

entries.name: AuXio
entries.tagline: Two-way simultaneous interpreter for emergency (123) calls that preserves critical words and alerts family.

entries.name: Bus Factor HQ
entries.tagline: Arcade simulator of organizational emergencies: what breaks if your key person is gone tomorrow.

entries.name: complAI
entries.tagline: Watches Colombian regulation for your company, alerts you where you live and opens the PR that makes you compliant.

entries.name: deley.com
entries.tagline: Know your judge before you face them.

entries.name: dipia
entries.tagline: Simulates the life that hasn't happened yet with the people already in your room.

entries.name: Helius
entries.tagline: Phone-to-phone emergency network to detect, locate and assist people during an earthquake, even without internet.

entries.name: Hippocamp
entries.tagline: Your network's memory, before you publish.

entries.name: HIVE
entries.tagline: Estimates how many people will comply with a policy and who bears the cost.

entries.name: Moirai
entries.tagline: Reads your blood test, simulates ten thousand ten-year futures and names the decision costing you the most years.

entries.name: NeuroEcho
entries.tagline: Audio synthesis engine generating new music that replicates the neural response of your favorite songs.

entries.name: Pa'lante
entries.tagline: Extracts and normalizes scattered financial context (email, PDFs, tax, credit bureau) and shares it with any AI agent via API/MCP with revocable per-section consent.

entries.name: Parallax
entries.tagline: Simulate a change before applying it, then measure how much of it was real.

entries.name: Peaje
entries.tagline: Put a toll on your website so AI agents discover it, use it and pay you.

entries.name: PLUMB
entries.tagline: Detects and prioritizes irregularity signals in Colombian public-works contracting using SECOP II data.

entries.name: Provenance Firewall
entries.tagline: Agent memory can change shape but cannot gain authority without explicit authorization.

entries.name: PULSE
entries.tagline: Unified emergency-security logic platform.

entries.name: PULSO
entries.tagline: From a paramedic's dictation to the hospital that can actually receive the patient, in under 90 seconds.

entries.name: Replica
entries.tagline: Emergency communication network that keeps working when infrastructure collapses.

entries.name: Roxy
entries.tagline: When agents delegate to other agents, verifies every action before it touches your data — and proves it.

entries.name: Stegora
entries.tagline: The creator's signature lives inside the file, not in a label that disappears when shared.

entries.name: TEMIS
entries.tagline: Voice assistant helping people draft and file health-rights legal actions with verifiable legal information.

entries.name: Vity
entries.tagline: Which building falls in the next earthquake, who it falls on and what it costs to prevent.

sources.note: Lists all submissions by track. Not results.
Organizer post: 36h with Anthropic at Buk, USD 3,000, teams of 3–5, best team to Chile final.

curator_notes: hack.platan.us root still lists Bogotá as 11–13 Sep 2026 (stale tour table); the edition page and organizer post say 21–23 Aug. /26-co/vote/results returned a server error. Emergencies was the most crowded track with Simulations (7 each).
